facts.text: Appendices to the final plan should provide depth rather than hide uncertainty from the main body.
facts.quote: **Appendices** should carry depth rather than hide uncertainty from the main body

facts.text: Appendix A of the final plan should contain a preliminary GSN or CAE argument.
facts.quote: A, preliminary GSN or CAE argument

facts.text: Appendix B of the final plan should contain an evidence plan and verification cross-reference matrix covering requirements, hazards, scenarios and evidence.
facts.quote: B, evidence plan and verification cross-reference matrix (requirements, hazards, scenarios, evidence)

facts.text: Appendix C of the final plan should contain an operating-envelope and scenario coverage map.
facts.quote: C, operating-envelope and scenario coverage map

facts.text: Appendix D of the final plan should contain a model credibility plan and assessment using NASA-STD-7009B factors.
facts.quote: D, model credibility plan and assessment (NASA-STD-7009B factors)

facts.text: Appendix E of the final plan should contain a pilot protocol with pre-registered progression criteria.
facts.quote: E, pilot protocol with pre-registered progression criteria

facts.text: Appendix F of the final plan should contain a detailed schedule, basis of estimate, reference-class data and elicitation records.
facts.quote: F, detailed schedule, basis of estimate, reference-class data and elicitation records

facts.text: Appendix G of the final plan should contain a risk and assumption register with quantitative schedule effects.
facts.quote: G, risk and assumption register with quantitative schedule effects

facts.text: Appendix H of the final plan should contain an expert consultation log, dissent log and red-team findings with dispositions.
facts.quote: H, expert consultation log, dissent log and red-team findings with dispositions

facts.text: Appendix I of the final plan should contain a standards and compliance matrix.
facts.quote: I, standards and compliance matrix

facts.text: Appendix J of the final plan should contain a long-lead item tracker.
facts.quote: J, long-lead item tracker

facts.text: Appendix K of the final plan should contain a data and configuration baseline.
facts.quote: K, data and configuration baseline

facts.text: Appendix L of the final plan should contain a glossary.
facts.quote: L, glossary

facts.text: The recommended gate scheme combines two schemes found in practice: a dated G0–G4 sequence and a feasibility-credibility-readiness-release sequence.
facts.quote: combines the two gate schemes found in practice: a dated G0 to G4 sequence and a feasibility-credibility-readiness-release sequence.

facts.text: Pass criteria for the recommended G0–G4 gates should be signed in advance.
facts.quote: Pass criterion (to be signed in advance)

facts.text: G0, the scope and evidence-plan gate, is scheduled for the end of November 2026. Passing requires an agreed claims and evidence plan, placed long-lead orders, sponsor-signed gate criteria and a named decider; allowed outcomes are go, restrict or stop.
facts.quote: | G0 scope and evidence plan | End of November 2026 | Claims and evidence plan agreed; long-lead orders placed; gate criteria signed by the sponsor; decider named | Go, restrict, stop |

facts.text: G1, the feasibility gate, is scheduled for the end of January 2027. Passing requires one scenario running end to end reproducibly under configuration control and an issued unresolved-assumption report; allowed outcomes are go, restrict, pivot or stop.
facts.quote: | G1 feasibility | End of January 2027 | One scenario runs end to end, reproducibly, under configuration control; unresolved-assumption report issued | Go, restrict, pivot, stop |

facts.text: G2, the credibility and delivery-readiness gate, is scheduled for March to April 2027. Passing requires a blind pilot meeting pre-set metrics inside its envelope, received assessor feedback, a P80 date inside the deadline, and an independent review finding readiness, restricted scope or fallback.
facts.quote: | G2 credibility and delivery readiness | March to April 2027 | Blind pilot meets pre-set metrics inside its envelope; assessor feedback received; P80 date inside the deadline; independent review says ready, restricted scope or fallback

facts.text: Allowed outcomes at G2, the credibility and delivery-readiness gate, are go, restrict, pivot or stop.
facts.quote: independent review says ready, restricted scope or fallback | Go, restrict, pivot, stop |

facts.text: G3, the coverage gate, is scheduled for the end of June 2027. Passing requires planned coverage to be reached with no open credibility defeaters on high-integrity claims; allowed outcomes are go, restrict or stop.
facts.quote: | G3 coverage | End of June 2027 | Planned coverage reached with no open credibility defeaters on high-integrity claims | Go, restrict, stop |

facts.text: G4, the evidence-release gate, is scheduled for August to September 2027. Passing requires an evidence package stating its envelope, limitations and residual uncertainty, with results supporting only the claims made; allowed outcomes are release, release with restrictions or withhold.
facts.quote: | G4 evidence release | August to September 2027 | Evidence package states envelope, limitations and residual uncertainty; results support only the claims made | Release, release with restrictions, withhold |

facts.text: A reusable one-page gate card should be used at every gate.
facts.quote: **A reusable gate card.** One page, used at every gate

facts.text: The reusable gate card should record the exact management decision, prerequisite knowledge, demonstrating evidence artifacts, objective adequacy threshold, open uncertainty and assumptions still relied on.
facts.quote: Decision (exactly what is management deciding?); Required knowledge (what must be known first?); Evidence (which artifacts demonstrate it?); Threshold (what objective criterion is adequate?); Open uncertainty; Assumptions still relied on

facts.text: The reusable gate card should record the current probability of meeting the next committed milestone, options of go, restricted go, pivot or stop, a fallback, qualified reviewers' dissent and reasons, and decision ownership and independent review authority.
facts.quote: Deadline probability (current chance of the next committed milestone); Options (go, restricted go, pivot, stop); Fallback; Dissent (which qualified reviewers disagree and why?); Authority (who owns the decision and who reviews it independently?)

facts.text: The reusable gate-card recommendation is expert opinion derived from GAO criterion-based decisions and DoD entrance and exit criteria.
facts.quote: **Expert opinion** derived from GAO criterion-based decisions and DoD entrance and exit criteria [3, 68].

facts.text: The evidence ledger is recommended as the most important working template: a one-page ledger with columns Claim ID, Claim, Evidence required, Method, Acceptance criterion, Owner, Due, Status and Limitation.
facts.quote: The most important working template is a one-page ledger with the columns Claim ID, Claim, Evidence required, Method, Acceptance criterion, Owner, Due, Status, Limitation.

facts.text: Example evidence-ledger row C-1 claims that model timing is adequate within envelope E, uses physical or bench correlation as evidence and a defined experiment as the method, and sets a pre-declared bound as the acceptance criterion.
facts.quote: C-1, "model timing is adequate within envelope E", physical or bench correlation, defined experiment, pre-declared bound

facts.text: Example evidence-ledger row C-2 claims that safety scenarios cover identified control-system hazards, uses a hazard-to-scenario trace as evidence and analysis plus review as the method, and requires no unexplained gaps.
facts.quote: C-2, "safety scenarios cover identified control-system hazards", hazard-to-scenario trace, analysis plus review, no unexplained gaps

facts.text: Example evidence-ledger row C-3 claims that results are reproducible, uses an independent re-run as evidence and configuration-controlled replay as the method, and sets a pre-specified repeatability criterion.
facts.quote: C-3, "results are reproducible", independent re-run, configuration-controlled replay, pre-specified repeatability criterion.

facts.text: The evidence-ledger recommendation is expert opinion grounded in assurance-case, NASA model-credibility and integrated test-and-evaluation principles.
facts.quote: **Expert opinion** grounded in assurance-case, NASA model-credibility and integrated test-and-evaluation principles [26, 9, 69].
